statement: This sketch creates a navigable open-world cityscape using p5.js's WEBGL renderer, where players can explore a sprawling urban environment. The scene features a grid-based city layout with buildings, roads, and interactive elements. A character can be moved through the environment using keyboard controls, and when the spacebar is pressed, the character performs an attack action that visually impacts the surrounding pavement. The implementation avoids performance bottlenecks by batching geometry calls and using efficient rendering techniques suitable for the frame budget constraints.
